name: cklph
description: Peter's personal Claude OS marketplace — authoritative skills, hooks, agents, and conventions.

plugins.name: cklph-os
plugins.description: Peter's personal Claude OS — authoritative skills, hooks, and conventions.

plugins.name: cklph-nextjs
plugins.description: Peter's opinionated Next.js + Supabase patterns. House style on top of the framework, complements vercel:* skills, not a replacement.

plugins.name: cklph-regression-watch
plugins.description: Baseline a live or staging site, re-check on demand or on a schedule, and surface only confirmed regressions (availability, SEO, tracking tag-firing, visual, journeys) with the evidence attached. On-demand, agent-interpreted; you own the data.

plugins.name: cklph-wp
plugins.description: Drive WordPress from Claude Code via wp-cli over SSH — connection to managed hosts, posts/meta/options/media, and the hard-won hosting gotchas. Foundation for cklph-elementor and cklph-figma-to-wp.

plugins.name: cklph-elementor
plugins.description: Read and write Elementor page/template data programmatically — the _elementor_data model, the CSS/responsive gotchas, theme-builder templates + conditions, and the global Kit. Builds on cklph-wp.

plugins.name: cklph-figma
plugins.description: Read designs from the Figma MCP (design context, screenshots, structure metadata, design tokens), preflight and verify Figma writes, and write a client's DESIGN.md tokens file with a lint and an alpha-aware contrast check. The design-source layer for any Figma-to-code work.

plugins.name: cklph-visual-qa
plugins.description: Verify a rendered web page VISUALLY against a design — headless-Chrome screenshots, ImageMagick crop/compare, overflow probes, the adversarial visual-reviewer agent, and a deterministic type and layout lint (impeccable). Framework-agnostic; pairs with cklph-figma.

plugins.name: cklph-diagram
plugins.description: Accessible, brand-correct diagrams as self-contained HTML with inline SVG, in 41 types, exported to SVG, PNG, GIF and MP4. A multi-brand token registry refuses to render a client whose brand is not onboarded, and WCAG AA is checked by script. Client brands live in ~/.config/cklph-diagram/brands, so updates never touch them. Imports draw.io, Mermaid and Excalidraw.

plugins.name: cklph-figma-to-wp
plugins.description: Orchestrate the full Figma to WordPress/Elementor pipeline: read the design, learn existing-page conventions, tokenize, generate Elementor JSON, write to a draft, and visually verify against Figma. Thin glue over cklph-figma, cklph-elementor, cklph-wp, and cklph-visual-qa.

plugins.name: cklph-audit
plugins.description: Adversarially verified whole-repo security audit. Twelve lenses (security, correctness, architecture, sca, iac, container, k8s, supply-chain, compliance, concurrency, state-machine, economic), plus opt-in docs-drift, omission, agent-config and ambiguity. Scanners find candidates (Semgrep, Trivy, gitleaks and more), Claude judges them, and a separate verifier tries to refute each one. Optional sandboxed exploit and patch steps. SOC 2 and CASA compliance matrix. Read-only by default.

plugins.name: cro-research-reporting
plugins.description: A strategist's toolkit: audit conversion funnels with evidence-tagged hypotheses, run customer (VoC) research, plan and read out A/B tests with real statistics, run deep sourced research, write conversion copy, and turn findings into render-safe reports. Uses AI where the evidence says it is reliable.

plugins.name: vuln-intel-ext
plugins.description: Sidecar MCP server extending cve-mcp with diff_since (what new CVEs hit my deps since my last scan), dependency snapshots, feed status, and WordPress vulnerability lookup. Powered by OSV.dev (30+ ecosystems, no API key required).

plugins.name: cklph-youtube
plugins.description: Get a YouTube video's transcript reliably: a five-method fallback chain (transcript API, watch-page captions, yt-dlp across player clients, optional proxy and cookies), then browser, connector or paste fallbacks when cloud IPs are blocked. Dependencies go in a private virtualenv where one can be created.
